newsitem.title: USA: Global Casinos to post $1.3 mln gain.
newsitem.headline: Global Casinos to post $1.3 mln gain.

text.p: Global Casinos Inc said it will post a one-time gain of $1.3 million from reorganizing its Global Casinos USA Inc unit, which operates the Bull Durham Saloon & Casino, under Chapter 11.
Global Casinos did not yet know to which quarter it would apply the gain, a company spokesman.

The plan will reduce the unit's total debt to $2.9 million from $5.4 million. It also requires Bull Durham to write off a note receivable and accrued interest from one of its secured lenders of about $1.2 million, the company said.
The unit received bankruptcy court approval for its reorganization plan on Wednesday, the spokesman said.
